title: The Road to Malopasso
invitation: You've had a taste of the basics. Grim Fronteira is even more fun with other players: turn Scum against your rivals, use your faction's full power, and try Azzardo and Dark mode. Gather your posse and play multiplayer!

gun.title: A gun before sundown
passages: The outlaw took everything except your name. Before you follow them, you need a gun. Behind a dusty counter, a trader rests one hand on an old revolver. Convince them to sell it.
The trader has heard your offer. This time, explain why leaving you unarmed would be bad for business.
The trader turns the revolver beneath the lamplight. Make one more offer before the shutters close.

outcomes.success: The trader takes your money and slides the revolver across the counter. You leave armed, with questions to ask.
outcomes.failure: The trader shakes their head. The gun stays on the counter. Find another way to persuade them.
outcomes.bust: A hand reaches for the trigger. You wrestle the gun away, but the struggle leaves you bleeding. You have your weapon, and your first scar.

witnesses.title: Loose tongues
passages: At the water queue, faces turn away when you describe the outlaw. Someone here knows where they went. Ask the right questions.
A mule driver waits outside the cantina. Perhaps a different witness will have fewer reasons to keep quiet.
An old woman watches the northern road. Ask what she saw, and listen before you speak again.

outcomes.success: A witness finally speaks: the outlaw is camping at Malopasso. The trail leads into the wilderness.
outcomes.failure: A shrug, a lie, a closing door. You learn nothing useful. Try somebody else.
outcomes.bust: Someone calls you the outlaw's accomplice. The crowd surges. You escape through a broken fence, wounded and still without an answer.

tracking.title: The Malopasso trail
passages: Beyond Malopasso, the wind combs the dry earth. A bootprint and a cold fire are all you have. Follow the outlaw's tracks.
The trail breaks on stony ground. Search the wash below the ridge for another sign.
Hoofprints cross your path, then vanish into thorn scrub. Find the trace that belongs to your quarry.

outcomes.success: Smoke rises beyond the ridge. Beside a small campfire sits the person you came to find. Your hand settles on the revolver.
outcomes.failure: The tracks double back into dust. The outlaw is still out there. Search another stretch of the wilderness.
outcomes.bust: A coyote bursts from the scrub and tears into you before you drive it off. Wounded, you return to the unfinished trail.

duel.title: No more running
passages: The outlaw rises beside the fire. Neither of you reaches for a greeting. Across the camp, the distance between two guns feels very small. Play your hand.

outcomes.success: Your shot ends the outlaw's story. But their associates heard the gunfire, and one is already coming over the ridge.
outcomes.failure: Your shot strikes stone. The outlaw disappears into the gully while an associate steps forward to cover their retreat.
outcomes.bust: The exchange leaves you bleeding. The outlaw slips away, and an associate comes down the ridge to finish the job.

associates.title: The company they kept
passages: A rider in a torn red coat blocks the trail. Their gun is already drawn. Survive this challenger.
From behind a ruined milestone, another of the outlaw's associates calls your name. There is no friendly way past.
Boots scrape the ridge above you. Another challenger has followed the sound of gunfire. Ready your hand.

outcomes.success: The challenger falls. For a moment the trail is quiet, but there are more footsteps in the dust.
outcomes.failure: You force the challenger back without settling the fight. Another figure takes their place.
outcomes.bust: You stagger out of the exchange wounded. Another associate is already approaching.

death.title: The trail ends here
death.text: Two wounds. Your trail ends here. Try again with a fresh deck and put what you learned to work.

ascension.title: You take the badge
ascension.text: Exactly 21 Reward points. Your name becomes a frontier legend, and this tale ends here — even if the hunt was unfinished.

exhaustion.title: You survived the hunt
exhaustion.text: The deck has run out. You survived this stretch of the Fronteira. This is a survival ending, not an exact-21 ascension. Try a fresh deck for another tale.
